description: This file contains the implementation of the VideoDecoderTestFixture class used for testing video decoders within the starboard media framework. It includes methods for initializing the decoder, handling decoder status updates, managing input buffers, and verifying decode targets, primarily for testing purposes.

classes.name: VideoDecoderTestFixture
classes.description: A fixture class for testing video decoder components, providing methods to initialize, feed input buffers, handle decoder events, and verify output validity.

methods.name: VideoDecoderTestFixture
methods.description: Constructor initializing the test fixture with necessary components such as job queue, graphics provider, test filename, output mode, and decoder type.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Sets up the video decoder and related components based on the test parameters and input video stream.

methods.name: OnDecoderStatusUpdate
methods.description: Handles status updates from the decoder, updating internal event queues accordingly.

methods.name: OnError
methods.description: Handles error events from the decoder.

methods.name: AssertInvalidDecodeTarget
methods.description: Checks that the current decode target is invalid when expected.

methods.name: WaitForNextEvent
methods.description: Waits for the next decoder event within a specified timeout.

methods.name: HasPendingEvents
methods.description: Checks if there are pending events in the event queue.

methods.name: GetDecodeTargetWhenSupported
methods.description: Retrieves and releases the current decode target if decode-to-texture mode is supported.

methods.name: AssertValidDecodeTargetWhenSupported
methods.description: Verifies that the current decode target is valid when decode-to-texture mode is supported.

methods.name: WriteSingleInput
methods.description: Feeds a single input buffer into the decoder, used when decoder needs more input.

methods.name: WriteEndOfStream
methods.description: Signals end of stream to the decoder.

methods.name: WriteMultipleInputs
methods.description: Feeds multiple input buffers into the decoder, handling events and errors.

methods.name: DrainOutputs
methods.description: Drains decoder outputs until end of stream or error occurs.

methods.name: ResetDecoderAndClearPendingEvents
methods.description: Resets the decoder and clears all pending events and internal state.

methods.name: GetVideoInputBuffer
methods.description: Retrieves a video input buffer for a given index from the test data.
